messages:
lina: quick sync  uploaded a small prototype for the guided tour that runs after creating a sample project (figma link). main ask: validate scroll behavior and microcopy.

omar: looked it over. two implementation concerns: 1) the tour overlays are currently absolutely positioned and cause page scroll jumps when shown; 2) on narrow viewports the tooltip arrow overlaps the shell header.

brett: for 1) we can render tour as position: fixed with an internal scroll container to avoid body jumps. for 2) we should clamp tooltip placement and fall back to bottom placement on small screens.

lina: agreed. spec update: render fixed, clamp at 70vh, internal scroll for long steps. fallback placements: bottom > top > left/right.

maria: copy recs: change step header from "Connect model" to "Connect a model to this project" and step button from "Next" to context-specific verbs ("Add model", "Run quickstart"). reduces ambiguity.

a11y-bot: accessibility checklist: 1) ensure role="dialog" + aria-modal for each step overlay; 2) add aria-describedby pointing to short step summary; 3) trap focus and restore on close; 4) announce step changes via aria-live polite region.

omar: implementation note: focus trap is doable but we need to handle nested focusable elements inside the quickstart iframe fallback path. recommend disabling iframe focus or using postMessage to surface actions in parent.

brett: alternative: avoid iframe for quickstarts and redirect to a dedicated quickstart route, then show the tour anchored to the page. simpler for focus and auth.

lina: preference is redirect + ephemeral tour overlay on the project page. i've added that to the spec.

a11y-bot: color contrast: the tooltip background uses --panel-90 which fails for small helper text in dark mode. increase contrast to meet 4.5:1 for body text or limit helper text size. also ensure focus ring uses --focus-strong token.

maria: microcopy for final toast: instead of "Project ready" use "Sample project ready  Open quickstart" to hint next action. also add translation key names in the copy sheet.

omar: analytics: add events tour_shown, tour_step_completed, tour_skipped. we should A/B test whether showing the tour immediately vs after first successful run improves completion. keys: tour_timing_immediate/delayed.

brett: small motion note: avoid auto-scrolling the page when the tour opens to first element; instead bring the tour into view without moving page unless necessary. reduces surprise. respect prefers-reduced-motion for any pan/scroll animation.

a11y-bot: keyboard nav: Tab should move through interactive controls, Arrow keys should move between tour steps when focus is on the tour. implement roving tabindex for step navigation.

lina: planning a paired QA session (design+eng+accessibility) next Tue 9am PT to validate behaviors across devices. will send invite and attach prototype + checklist.

maria: please lock copy by Monday EOD so i18n can start. i'll add the translation keys and ping when ready.

omar: opening ENG-4888 for implementation. will include feature flag for staged rollout. PR link to follow.

brett: PR preview requested  i'll attach storybook deploy for visual QA.

a11y-bot: reminder: attach accessibility lint report to PR and include keyboard + screenreader test steps.

lina: thanks all  small ask: drop any last microcopy tweaks in-thread before EOD Monday.
